title: Shell Island Excursions
specs: Wild bottlenose dolphins in natural habitat
Explore pristine, untouched Shell Island beaches
Possible sightings of manatees, eagle rays, manta rays, sea turtles, sharks
Customizable private charters with local expert captain
Maximum 6 guests per vessel per Coast Guard regulations
Must have valid Florida fishing license if bringing fishing gear on Custom Adventure Tours
Well-behaved dogs welcome with leash and water bowl
Private tours for up to 6 guests per boat
Can arrange second boat for groups up to 12 with discounts
includes: Large iced cooler onboard for drinks and snacks
Complimentary bottled water on all trips
Complimentary snacks and soft drinks on extended tours
Quality audio system with Bluetooth connectivity
Kids’ life jackets, beach toys, and shelling tools
blurb: Guests take private boat tours with a USCG-licensed captain to watch dolphins and explore Shell Island. Tours include snorkeling, swimming, beach time, and wildlife viewing. Trips are customizable and suitable for families, couples, and small groups.
extraNote: Full payment required at time of booking · Cancel or reschedule less than 24 hours in advance forfeits full trip cost · 4% booking fee added to online transactions · Captain's call on weather; no severe lightning · Tipping customary: 15-20% standard, 25% for exceptional service · Point South Bay Point Marina at 3824 Hatteras Lane, Panama City Beach, FL 32408
